**Upstream resource name and canonical HTTPS URL**

**Which ecosystem category?**
headwear / acquisition_hardware / acquisition_software / streaming / analysis / benchmark / data_standard / data_archive / cad / retrieval / community

**Openness and permissions**
Is this open hardware, open-source software, an open standard, public data platform, a community or a hosted service? Cite the exact source where the authors define this. **Do not assume permissive reuse from an open webpage.**

**Pinned upstream version or access date**
State the release/commit/DOI if known. If not, explicitly mark "not pinned".

**What new problem does it solve?**
Compare with an existing catalog entry; provide one useful integration or reproduction question.

**What's missing or unsafe to assume?**
Mention scientific, electrical, licensing, data-privacy and compatibility blockers.

**Legal and data guard**
Links and short original summaries **only**. No copied papers, firmware, standards, source archives, private EEG or participant head scans.
